sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:50

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:50:1
items.html:
These lights that are from the Chazeh downward come covered: That is to say, that the discernment of GAR in them is covered in the posterior of Ima. And you must know here that the complete correction of ZON is that their GAR be covered in the posterior of Ima and their ZAT be revealed. For then their ten Sefirot are corrected in the likeness of the ten Sefirot of the Bina of direct light. For the Bina of direct light too is included of ten Sefirot: of Keter and Hochma, which are above her, and also of the ZAT that are below her, which are her discernments of ZON, called Tevuna, as above (page 523, the passage beginning “And still.” Study it there well). And it was explained there that from the moment Bina began to draw the illumination of Hochma for the sake of ZON, she is already regarded as Tevuna and as her ZAT, which means the roots that remained in Bina, which the ZAT left with her after they had gone out to their own place. But Bina herself is discerned as she is at the beginning of her emanation, that is, in the light of Hassadim with her posterior toward Hochma. See there. Thus the GAR of Bina are covered together with her posterior, and only her ZAT were revealed in the illumination of Hochma. And therefore ZA too, at the time when he is corrected like her, his GAR being covered in the posterior of Bina and his ZAT revealed in the illumination of Hochma, is then found in complete correction.
And this is what he says, “that these lights from the Chazeh downward come covered, for the concealment of the light and its covering constitutes its correction” — that is, as above, since the Rosh of Tevuna already clothes upon the posterior of the upper AVI, which are corrected with the correction of lines, as above (page 528, the passage beginning “And with.” Study it there well). Therefore the lights of TNHYM that expanded from them, in each of which there are ten Sefirot, as is known — their GAR were covered in the posterior of Ima, and the discernment of the illumination of Hochma was only in their ZAT. And this is similar to the ten Sefirot of ZA at the time of his correction, as above. And this is what is written, “for the concealment of the light and its covering constitutes its correction,” since the correction comes about in this very way in the ZA of Atzilut as well, as above. This is not so with the lights of HGT, which had no correction whatsoever from the posterior of Ima; rather, all their ten Sefirot were revealed, even the GAR in each one of them, and therefore their breaking was harsher than that of the NHY.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:50:2
items.html: At the time of the correction of his Partzuf it comes in reverse: For in the correction he is found with his HGT corrected in the posterior of Ima, which is the screen of the Yesod of Ima, clothed in his Tifferet up to the Chazeh; and from the Chazeh downward the illumination of Hochma in Hassadim is revealed in him. That is, as above, that his GAR, which are HGT, are covered in the screen, and in the NHY, which are the ZAT of ZA, the Hassadim are revealed. And this is the reverse of the ZA of Nekudim, whose HGT were entirely revealed, as above in the adjacent item, and whose NHY were covered. And this correction began in the NHY of Nekudim, which came out clothed in the posterior of Ima, as above, and it was completed in the world of Atzilut, as written in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:50:3
items.html: The revealed Hassadim strike them and their light goes out to the outside: For the Hassadim are revealed only in the middle line of ZA, which is by means of the Yesodot of AVI that are clothed there; but in the extremities the posterior of Ima govern. However, the reflected light rises from below upward and strikes the two lines, right and left, and brings their lights out to the outside, as is written well in its place. And know that these lights that go out to the outside because of the striking are the lights of the NHY of each and every Sefira, which were there in each one of them in the discernment of “and their posterior inward,” meaning that they were included in the HGT of each one, as above (page 506, the passage beginning “The secret of the drop.” Study it there well). And now, through the striking of the revealed Hassadim of the middle line upon the Sefirot of the extremities, the NHY of each one are able to come out from their inclusion in the HGT and to be revealed outwardly, in the discernment of posterior that are completed in the illumination of Hochma, so that they no longer have any fear whatsoever of the sucking of the external ones. See there on page 506, and understand this well. And you already know that striking means diminution, for when two lights that are opposite to one another meet together, they diminish one another, and out of this a new illumination is joined and born. So it is here: since the Hassadim that are revealed in the illumination of Hochma are opposite to the Sefirot that are in the two extremities, which by force of the posterior of Ima in them are found to reject Hochma, they therefore strike one another, and out of their striking new NHY are born and revealed in the illumination of Hochma, as above. And the completion of the matter will be explained in its place.
